reviews_captured_by_me.text: Mr. Garibay was recommended by a neighborhood friend to replace my floors.  He came by the day after I contacted him and provided a quote the next morning.  His quote wasn’t cheap but it was reasonable.  I accepted his quote on Friday.  He began Monday morning and was finished by noon on Tuesday.  His price included painting and moving furniture.  He did a great job, and most importantly, showed up when he said he would and efficiently finished the job without any delay or gaps in work.  I was very thankful to work with a trustworthy contractor that did a great job.  I would absolutely recommend them for quality, trustworthy work.

reviews_captured_by_me.text: We've been working with them for many years, and they always do a fantastic job. Most recently, they installed new floors for us, and we loved the results. The installation was smooth, professional, and everything turned out beautifully. They were extremely punctual and respectful of our time, which we truly appreciate. We 100% recommend them!

Garibay Flooring Company did an outstanding job on our home renovation project. Their team was professional, punctual, and paid close attention to every detail. The quality of the materials and craftsmanship exceeded our expectations, and the results truly transformed our space. Communication throughout the process was clear and responsive, making the experience smooth from start to finish. I highly recommend Garibay Flooring Company to anyone looking for top-notch flooring services.
